document.title: Basic Calculation of a Buck Converter's Power Stage

1.says: D = VOUT / (VIN(max) x eta), the duty cycle at the greatest input

2.says: dIL = (VIN(max) - VOUT) x D / (fS x L), fS the least switching frequency

3.says: IMAXOUT = ILIM(min) - dIL / 2, the most the IC can give

4.says: ISW(max) = dIL / 2 + IOUT(max), the peak the inductor and the switch carry

efficiency.where: section 2, page 2: an estimated 90 %, when the datasheet gives no efficiency

note.inductor_rule: section 3, page 3: the inductor must have a higher current rating than the current of equation 4
note.inductor_choice: section 3, page 3: when the datasheet gives a range of inductors, choose 1 from it
note.output_choice: section 7, page 5: an internally compensated converter takes the inductor and capacitor values its datasheet recommends
note.not_used: equations 5 and 6 (an inductor when the datasheet names none), 7 and 8 (a rectifier diode: the ICs below are synchronous, section 1), 9 and 10 (R2 from the feedback bias current, which the datasheets below do not state), 12 to 14 (an externally compensated converter's output capacitor)

amps_max.where: section 6.3, Recommended Operating Conditions, IOUT, page 4

vout_min.where: section 6.3, Recommended Operating Conditions, VOUT from 0.6 V to VIN, page 4

ilim_min.where: section 6.5, Electrical Characteristics, ILIM of the DBV package, the column MIN, page 5

henries.where: section 8.2.2.3, table 4, the cells marked ++ and its note 3 (the standard value), page 9

henries_low.where: section 8.2.2.3, table 4, note 1: the effective inductance can vary by +20 % and -30 %, page 9

saturation_margin.where: section 8.2.2.4, page 10: a saturation current about 20 % to 30 % above IL,MAX; the block asks the least, 20 %

r2_max.where: section 8.2.2.2, page 9: a maximum of 200 kohm for R2

output_farads.where: section 8.2.2.3, table 4, the cell marked ++ of each row of VOUT (2 x 22, 22 and 10 uF), page 9

kept_share.where: section 8.2.2.3, table 4, note 2: the effective capacitance can vary by -50 %, page 9

output_span.where: section 8.2.2.5, page 10: designed to operate with an output capacitor of 10 uF to 47 uF

dielectrics.where: section 8.2.2.5, page 10: X7R or X5R dielectric is recommended; TI SLVA477C, sections 6 and 7, page 5: X5R or better

input_farads.where: section 8.2.2.5, page 10: 4.7 uF of input capacitance is sufficient for most applications
